REMOVAL OF OIL FILTER BRACKET

1. DRAIN ENGINE OIL

2. REMOVE NO.4 AIR CLEANER PIPE WITH NO.1 AND NO.2
AIR CLEANER HOSES

3. REMOVE NO.7 AIR CLEANER HOSE
(a) Disconnect the air hoses from ISC pipe, air intake connector and PVC pipe.
(b) Disconnect the air flow meter connector.
(c) Loosen the two clamps and unlock the air cleaner case clip.
(d) Remove the bolt and No.7 air cleaner hose.
(e) Disconnect the PS idle up air hose.
